calibration_at_equal_error.conclusion: temperature/Platt/isotonic applied IN-SAMPLE do not lower the review share at equal gold error (monotone maps cannot reorder the frontier); the raw/in-sample curves are within noise. The *_loco curves show a lower review only because fold-specific fits change WHICH windows are decided - a small-sample artefact, not a real gain.

exact_boundary_note: widest half-width with review share < 60% on the 0.001 grid is ~0.177; on the prescribed 0.02 grid it is 0.16 (review 53.4%)

protocol.gold: 150 IndEgo human gold (100 good/50 bad), single labeller; LOCO over 7 clips
protocol.insample: global calibrator fit on all 150 gold then applied to gold (optimistic for the fit) and to E8/OOD
protocol.loco: calibrator fit on 6 clips, applied to the 7th (honest deployable estimate)
protocol.ood: 60 human-labelled Egocentric-10K (51 good/9 bad); PRE-REGISTERED test, evaluation only, never fit on

what: fine sweep (step 0.005), calibration consistency check, and figure (supports Y1.01.json)
